meta.title: PO Hold: refused for a user without the Buyer / Approver role
gaps: Open the purchase order screen and attempt PO Hold as a user without the Buyer or Approver role.
Repeat PO Hold as a Buyer or Approver and compare whether the action is available and succeeds.
Verify the same-tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are intentionally granted PO Hold access.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the purchase order screen and attempt PO Hold as a user without the Buyer or Approver role.; Repeat PO Hold as a Buyer or Approver and compare whether the action is available and succeeds.; Verify the same-tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are intentionally granted PO Hold access.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Buyer or Approver role and as a Buyer or Approver in the same tenant, open the purchase order screen, attempt PO Hold with both users, and report whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access purchase orders, perform PO Hold, or obtain the required alternate user sessions.
Final assertion required by the plan format; it only checks that the resulting screen has no crash or raw error and does not cover PO Hold.
